verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own high-volume bulk data movement: the Raw Event Export API is recommended for high-volume exports, the Engage API exports user profiles, and Warehouse Connectors sync data in from Snowflake, BigQuery and others. That covers bulk read and ingest, but nothing shows batch actions that act on or change many existing items at once. missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete/edit operations on events, profiles, or reports; batch endpoints usable by AI agents (e.g. via MCP); independent or hands-on corroboration.
